evidence.detail: rs/r/b is a static int -> int[][] table keyed by exact model ids including 65295, 65328, 2467 and 42467; each row is a two-integer selector/value pair consumed only by R30 Model.
Model applies each table row to its per-face integer array L, using direct face indices or special -1/-2/-3/-4 selectors that expand through model face-group arrays before assigning value+1.
During live model rendering Model reads L[face]-1 as an index into the R50 ParticleDefinition array rs/r/c.c and spawns that definition through R306 CpuParticlePool from the selected face geometry.
The table therefore configures which model faces/groups emit which particle definitions; it does not recolor faces or alter generic model geometry independently of the particle spawn path.

proposals.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 model-face to ParticleDefinition attachment behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
